tools.name: continuity_audit
tools.title: continuity audit
tools.description: Returns locked canon alongside a short proposed scene as evidence for continuity comparison. It does not automatically identify contradictions, save the scene, or approve it.

tools.name: create_story_project
tools.title: create story project
tools.description: Creates a new private story project requested by the user. Does not save canon or scenes.

tools.name: get_canon_history
tools.title: get canon history
tools.description: Returns previous and new content for a saved canon entry, newest first, without changing data.

tools.name: get_continuity_context
tools.title: get continuity context
tools.description: Retrieves relevant canon, recent approved scenes, and the latest provisional checkpoint for a saved story. The request parameter is a brief scene or topic query, not a chat transcript. Results are a ranked selection rather than the complete story bible.

tools.name: list_approved_scenes
tools.title: list approved scenes
tools.description: Lists approved scene summaries in story order with offset-based pagination.

tools.name: list_story_checkpoints
tools.title: list story checkpoints
tools.description: Returns provisional story checkpoints with offset-based pagination. Checkpoints are resumable notes rather than approved canon.

tools.name: list_story_projects
tools.title: list story projects
tools.description: Lists the authenticated user's saved story projects with their IDs and offset-based pagination.

tools.name: record_approved_scene
tools.title: record approved scene
tools.description: Stores a concise summary of a user-approved scene. An occupied scene number is preserved unless replaceExisting is true for a user-requested replacement. Identical retries return the saved scene.

tools.name: save_story_checkpoint
tools.title: save story checkpoint
tools.description: Saves user-authorized story progress as provisional notes, separate from canon and approved scenes. Accepts focused story state, unresolved ideas, and next steps rather than full transcripts or unrelated personal data. The same checkpointId makes retries idempotent.

tools.name: search_story_canon
tools.title: search story canon
tools.description: Searches saved canon by literal title or content text. An empty query browses entries with offset-based pagination.

tools.name: upsert_canon_entry
tools.title: upsert canon entry
tools.description: Saves user-approved facts or canon revisions. LOCKED represents facts approved as established canon. Existing entries require their current expectedRevision; conflicting edits fail without overwriting. Identical retries preserve revision history.

canon.description: false marks a temporary, alternate, or what-if entry as non-canon. Omit to keep the current value; new entries default to canon.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 date or datetime after which a non-canon or temporary entry expires. Omit to keep, null to clear.
